title: Tenant isolation profile register
description: Per tenant: cell, profile, shared stores used, and the history of profile and control changes as append-only events.

title: Routing and pooling negative test results
description: Results of spoofed tenant hint, multi-tenant user, revoked delegation and pooled-connection leakage tests (RR-UNB-TEN-004-r1 AC-1 to AC-3).
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Tenant context construction and analyzer report
description: Build evidence that governed modules open data access only through tenant-bound units of work, with analyzer results for raw connections, reflection and unsafe code, linked to build provenance.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Grant and RLS gate report
description: Strata diff of grants and RLS plus the forced-RLS and cell-confinement check per deployment.
producer: Strata (pilot; exists, not operated for production) plus not yet assigned check
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Database routine and naming review
description: List of SECURITY DEFINER routines with search path settings and review records; naming convention conformance for shared clusters.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Isolation test matrix results
description: Per build and profile: results for every row of the isolation test matrix.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Canary probe telemetry
description: Continuous record of cross-tenant probe attempts and outcomes, with alerts.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Secondary store isolation map
description: Each cache, queue, index, bucket and log stream with its tenant key and isolation test reference.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: AI retrieval logs and data-use register
description: Per AI session: initiating principal, tenant context, retrieved resource IDs; register of any training or evaluation use of tenant data with rights basis.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Key service configuration and destruction certificates
description: Per-cell key inventory, access policies, rotation and destruction events, and certificates.
format: Key service audit export and signed certificate
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Per-tenant performance and contention monitoring
description: Per-tenant latency, error and quota metrics with contention alerts; surge test results.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Partner scope and branding validation records
description: Partner data-class authorizations, cross-partner denial tests, branding validation results and partner exit case reconciliation.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Lifecycle and ExitPackage manifest
description: Lifecycle transitions with readiness evidence; migration equivalence and reconciliation reports; signed ExitPackage manifest with digests, counts and trial balances.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Independent tenant isolation test report and customer-run two-tenant test results
description: Cross-tenant section of an independent penetration test (cross-tenant reads and writes, spoofed routing hints, pooled connection reuse, background jobs, caches, AI retrieval, deploy-path RLS removal) with retest evidence, plus results of customer-run tests using two provisioned test tenants.
producer: Independent penetration testing firm (not engaged); customers
format: Report or letter (PDF) with scope, period and issuer
